tool.description: VarScan2 is a tool for variant detection in massively parallel sequencing data. It can detect SNPs, indels, and copy number variations in both somatic and germline samples. It is particularly useful for analyzing tumor/normal sample pairs. Subtool fpfilter is used to filter a set of SNPs/indels based on coverage, reads, p-value, etc.

tool.help:
**varscan_fpfilter**
VarScan2 is a tool for variant detection in massively parallel sequencing data. It can detect SNPs, indels, and copy number variations in both somatic and germline samples. It is particularly useful for analyzing tumor/normal sample pairs. Subtool fpfilter is used to filter a set of SNPs/indels based on coverage, reads, p-value, etc.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: varscan/fpfilter - Container: biocontainers/varscan/fpfilter:latest
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
